note: Ratchet of the FE GPU / streaming / profiling contract (audits/2026-10-22/fe_gpu_coverage.md). A module leaves 'pending' when it meets every point and enters 'compliant'. The list only shrinks: a new FE module must meet the contract at once.

exempt._basis_cells_ktc: the tuner entry of the device basis-cell path (kernel_tuner fe_basis_cells_device, sweep over the row count against the host variant at 1e-6 equivalence, fallback = the measured row mark, MLFRAME_BASIS_CELLS_DEVICE=0|1 forces a side): it owns no kernel and no array work; the cell kernels and their profile belong to _orthogonal_routing_device and _orthogonal_adaptive_degree_device, which are tracked in this registry as pending
exempt._basis_name_codes: engineered-column name codes and a regular expression that splits a column name; string handling only, no array work
exempt._cat_pair_search_tuner: the tuner entry of _gpu_pairs (cat_pair_search_backend): it owns no kernel, it times the njit pair search against the batched device pair MI of _gpu_pairs, which meets the contract (profile record _gpu_pairs.md)
exempt._composite_group_agg_fe: per-group mean/std/count over integer key codes: a numba kernel bit-equal to pandas (2 ms per 20000-row column, 30 columns x 3 stats in 0.062 s); the candidate scoring that follows is the device-batched CMI (batched_cmi_gpu, chunked on OOM). A device twin would need the pandas Kahan/Welford order replayed per group to stay bit-equal and saves less than its own column transfer (audit 73cm); revisit if the generation share of a fit grows
exempt._conditional_gate_fe_helpers: measured exemption: _scan_gate_column enumerates the (operand, operand, gate) triples and queues them with _add (one quantile grid of 17 thresholds per gate column); the scoring of the queued candidates is the njit prange scan of _conditional_gate_fe, which carries its own entry. Enumeration alone with a no-op queue: 1805 candidates in 3.7 ms (20000 rows, 20 operands, 5 gates) and 12168 in 26 ms (100000 rows, 40 operands, 8 gates) on the host (2026-11-15, min of 5)
exempt._conditional_gate_naming: builds engineered column names and frozen recipe records from strings and floats; no array work, no kernel (carved out of _conditional_gate_fe for file size)
exempt._conditional_quantile_rank_fe: measured exemption: its only consumer is the fe_conditional_quantile_rank_enable region, 0.28 s of a 141 s CPU fit at n=20000 (under 0.5 s, audits/2026-10-22/profiles/fe_family_walls_cpu_n20000.md); a device twin has no payoff at this shape. Re-profile and move it back to pending if the region crosses 0.5 s at another n or column count
exempt._confirm_predictor_engineered: ordering and decision helpers around the single-predictor confirmation: bookkeeping, no numeric kernel
exempt._encoding_recipes: transform-time replay and builder layer of the encoding recipes (kfold target encoding, count, frequency, cat-num residual, cat pair/triple cross): it validates the recipe, extracts ONE source column and hands the stored lookup to apply_target_encoding / apply_count_encoding of _target_encoding_fe and _count_freq_interaction_fe, which stay pending in this registry; no array work of its own
exempt._family_maxt_gate_device: measured exemption: dispatched by data residency, not by a crossover. Resident device batches take the device gate (kernels in _family_maxt_cuda_bits, recorded in its profile), anything else the host gate; on the same family the resident placement is faster at every measured size (20000 rows 0.009 vs 0.013 s, 100000 rows 0.031 vs 0.059, 400000 rows 0.029 vs 0.297; audits/2026-10-22/profiles/_family_maxt_gate_device.md), so there is no region where the other side wins and nothing for a sweep to choose. The module is orchestration over the bit-set kernels (no kernel of its own, no CPU twin: the host gate is _family_maxt_gate). Revisit when the residency scenarios are rolled out (RES11-01): the entry would then be the device-in scenario of the family gate.

exempt._fe_batch_dispatch: backend dispatcher of the FE batcher: picks _fe_cpu_batch or _fe_gpu_batch by flags, hardware and a tuning-cache lookup; it owns no kernel and no data pass, both backends carry their own entries
exempt._fe_batched_mi_blocks: column-block driver around the one-shot batched CMI (blocks sized from the free VRAM, pieces joined in order): orchestration, it launches no kernel of its own (the kernels live in _fe_batched_mi and _fe_batched_mi_cmi)

exempt._fourier_core_cycles: measured exemption: the tail-aliasing guard of the Fourier detectors: core_span is one np.quantile of the two core quantiles over a column, 0.54 ms at 20000 rows and 2.1 ms at 100000 (2026-11-15, min of 7 x 20), once per detected column per detector pass, so about 0.2 s for 100 columns at 100000 rows against the 3.58 s of the fe_univariate_fourier_enable region (audits/2026-10-22/profiles/fe_family_walls_gpu_n100000_p100.md); freq_is_tail_aliased is a scalar product. The detectors that call it carry their own device paths. Re-profile if the guard crosses 0.5 s at another n or column count

exempt._gpu_strict_fe: scaffold whose entry point raises NotImplementedError and is superseded by the per-family device-born predicates: no numeric kernel
exempt._hermite_fe_diverse: measured exemption: greedy diverse-top-M choice over the coefficient history of one Hermite pair search (vectors of about a dozen coefficients); 0.21 ms for 200 history entries and 2.3 ms for 2000 on the host (2026-11-15, min of 7 x 5), once per pair search; the pair search itself is device-scored elsewhere
exempt._hermite_fe_optimise_helpers: measured exemption: in-place compaction of the finite candidate rows of the Hermite batch (a row copy per non-finite gap); 100 pairs x 12 basis functions x 30000 rows float32: 0.36 ms when every row is finite (no copy), 14 ms with half the rows non-finite and 25 ms with a tenth non-finite, i.e. the memory copy of up to 130 MB at host bandwidth, not Python overhead (2026-11-15, min of 7); a fancy-index form would copy the same bytes into a temporary as large as the batch, so it is not faster and doubles the peak memory. The row fill before it is the njit prange kernel, and the MI scoring after it is device-batched
